heading: Differential Feeder

text: MBCI and MCRI are under last time buy. Orders may be placed until 27th January 2027 and will be fulfilled based upon availability. For MRTP, Contact Us for availability.
heading: Differential Feeder

text: Differential feeder protection requires a comparison of the currents entering and leaving the protected zone.
heading: Differential Feeder

text: Two MBCI relays are therefore required, one for each end of the feeder. A pair of pilot wires is used to transmit information between the two relays so that each may be able to compare the current flowing at its respective end with the current the other.
heading: Differential Feeder

text: The pilot wire carries analog circulating current - allowing correct operation even for low specification or ageing pilots.
heading: Differential Feeder

text: When applying this protection to overhead lines, the limiting factor is generally the length of the pilot circuits: for cable feeders the limiting factors are more likely to be the level of line charging current and the method of system earthing.
heading: Differential Feeder

text: Key benefits:
High stability for through faults
heading: Key benefits:

text: Fast operation for in zone faults
heading: Key benefits:

text: Simultaneous tripping of relays at each line end
heading: Key benefits:
